findings.description: The customer-managed KMS key does not set `enable_key_rotation`, which defaults to false, so the underlying cryptographic material is never rotated. Because this key encrypts an audit trail bucket, a single compromised or long-lived key version indefinitely exposes all historical audit data, and the extended crypto-period increases the blast radius of any key material disclosure.
